prompt: Inside a spacious greenhouse, sunlight streams through a curved glass roof supported by a steel frame. Long wooden benches hold potted ferns, orchids, and succulents in clay pots. A metal table displays seed packets beside a watering can and a coiled garden hose. Pruning shears and a small spade rest on a shelf above a wooden crate filled with plant trays and label stakes. A digital thermostat and a wall-mounted thermometer hang by a humidifier vent near a circulation fan, while fluorescent lights run along the steel beams. A wheelbarrow stands beside a bag of potting soil by a sturdy workbench. There is no plastic bag, no paper flyer, no insect, no puddle, and no bicycle.
